claim: Marseille's Bouches-du-Rhône department has no 2-star Michelin restaurants; only 3-star and 1-star tiers exist in the city
quote: Le Petit Nice (Marseille), AM par Alexandre Mazzia (Marseille), La Villa Madie (Cassis) — all three-star; no two-star entries in Bouches-du-Rhône

claim: Marseille has exactly two 3-star restaurants and four 1-star restaurants; no 2-star restaurants listed
quote: Le Petit Nice Passedat - 3 Michelin stars; AM par Alexandre Mazzia - 3 Michelin stars; L'Épuisette, Une Table au Sud - 1 Michelin star

claim: Le Petit Nice Passedat offers five tasting menus ranging from €230 to €490 and is located at Anse de Maldormé on the Corniche
quote: Maldormé Menu: €230 (lunch only) · Calanques Menu: €310 · Passedat Menu: €350 · My Bouille Abaisse: €390 · Sea Discovery Menu: €490

claim: AM par Alexandre Mazzia's Premier Pas lunch menu is priced at €115 (Wed–Fri); dinner menus range up to €435
quote: Menu Premier Pas €115 (mercredi-vendredi, déjeuner seulement); dîner à partir de €295–€435

claim: La Villa Madie offers three menus: Anse De l'Arène €195 (4 acts, Thu–Fri lunch), Cap Canaille €295 (6 acts), Les Agapes €380 (8 acts); open Thu–Sun
quote: Menu Anse De l'Arène €195 – Served in 4 acts – available for lunch only on Thursdays and Fridays (except July/August and public holidays)

claim: Le Petit Nice has three Michelin stars and focuses on local seafood with exceptional fish-based sauces; Une Table au Sud and L'Épuisette each hold one star
quote: Located in a 5-star hotel with panoramic sea views. Focuses on local seafood and forgotten rockfish.

claim: Le Petit Nice kitchen works with 65+ fish species caught on long-lines with minimal butter; panoramic sea views; some diners find flavour profile subtle and minimalist
quote: uses over 65 species, caught with longlines, emphasizing minimal use of butter or cream; experiences vary: some praise exquisite quality, others find service inconsistencies

claim: Alexandre Mazzia earned the third Michelin star in 2021; he played basketball for Marseille 2001–2007 before training under Michel Bras, Santi Santamaria, and Martín Berasategui
quote: He played professional basketball for Marseille (2001-2007) while simultaneously working at prestigious Michelin-starred establishments under chefs Michel Bras, Santi Santamaria, and Martín Berasategui

claim: AM par Alexandre Mazzia is 24 seats, rated 4.7/5 on TripAdvisor; wine pairings add €185+; some reviewers note tiny portions and rushed pacing
quote: €435-495 per dinner excluding drinks; wine pairings cost €185+ for five small glasses; some found dishes overwhelming; service rushed through 5+ courses before wine arrived

claim: La Villa Madie holds 3 Michelin stars (earned 2022), rated 4.7/5 on TripAdvisor; Dimitri Droisneau visits tables personally; spectacular Cap Canaille sea views
quote: Chef Dimitri Droisneau personally visits tables, which reviewers appreciate as increasingly rare at fine dining establishments; situated in Anse Corton overlooking the Mediterranean with views of Cap Canaille

claim: La Villa Madie also operates Brasserie du Corton above the main restaurant at approximately €70 per person as a more accessible entry point
quote: In 2024, Marielle & Dimitri Droisneau launched Brasserie du Corton, located just above the main restaurant — Michelin star food at a more affordable price of around €70 euros

claim: No 2-star restaurants are listed in the Bouches-du-Rhône/Marseille area; Marseille's Michelin presence is limited to 3-star and 1-star tiers
quote: Le Petit Nice - Marseille; AM par Alexandre Mazzia - Marseille — both three-star; no two-star entries in the Bouches-du-Rhône area visible

claim: Auffo in Marseille (Coline Faulquier, Top Chef finalist) earned a new 1-star in the 2026 Michelin Guide
quote: Auffo, niché au cœur de Marseille et tenu par Coline Faulquier, ancienne finaliste de Top Chef, a reçu sa première étoile Michelin en 2026

claim: Le Petit Nice Passedat accepts online reservations via TheFork; closed Sunday and Monday
quote: Le Petit Nice Passedat – Gérald Passedat, closed Sunday and Monday, bookable online

claim: AM par Alexandre Mazzia's name plays on the French word for soul (âme) and the chef's initials; the restaurant holds 3 Michelin stars and 5 Gault&Millau toques
quote: Alexandre Mazzia – 3* Guide Michelin – 5 Toques Gault&Millau
